title: Spectroscopic and In Silico Studies on the Interaction of Substituted Pyrazolo[1,2-a]benzo[1,2,3,4]tetrazine-3-one Derivatives with c-Myc G4-DNA.
authors: Mulliri, Simone; Laaksonen, Aatto; Spanu, Pietro; Farris, Riccardo; Farci, Matteo; Mingoia, Francesco; Roviello, Giovanni N; Mocci, Francesca
one_liner_zh: 该文结合光谱实验与分子对接/MD模拟研究小分子配体与c-Myc启动子G-四链体DNA的互作及稳定性影响，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属蛋白-DNA互作相关且方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Herein we describe a combined experimental and in silico study of the interaction of a series of pyrazolo[1,2-a]benzo[1,2,3,4]tetrazin-3-one derivatives (PBTs) with parallel G-quadruplex (GQ) DNA aimed at correlating their previously reported anticancer activities and the stabilizing effects observed by us on c-myc oncogene promoter GQ structure. Circular dichroism (CD) melting experiments were performed to characterize the effect of the studied PBTs on the GQ thermal stability. CD measurements indicate that two out of the eight compounds under investigation induced a slight stabilizing effect (2-4  degrees C) on GQ depending on the nature and position of the substituents. Molecular docking results allowed us to verify the modes of interaction of the ligands with the GQ and estimate the binding affinities. The highest binding affinity was observed for ligands with the experimental melting temperatures (T(m)s). However, both stabilizing and destabilizing ligands showed similar scores, whilst Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, performed across a wide range of temperatures on the GQ in water solution, either unliganded or complexed with two model PBT ligands with the opposite effect on the T(m)s, consistently confirmed their stabilizing or destabilizing ability ascertained by CD. Clues about a relation between the reported anticancer activity of some PBTs and their ability to stabilize the GQ structure of c-myc emerged from our study. Furthermore, Molecular Dynamics simulations at high temperatures are herein proposed for the first time as a means to verify the stabilizing or destabilizing effect of ligands on the GQ, also disclosing predictive potential in GQ-targeting drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一项结合实验与计算机模拟的研究，探讨一系列吡唑并[1,2-a]苯并[1,2,3,4]四嗪-3-酮衍生物（PBTs）与平行G-四链体（GQ）DNA的相互作用，旨在关联其先前报道的抗癌活性及我们观察到的对c-myc癌基因启动子GQ结构的稳定效应。采用圆二色谱（CD）熔解实验来表征所研究PBTs对GQ热稳定性的影响。CD测量表明，在所研究的八个化合物中，有两个化合物根据取代基的性质和位置，对GQ诱导了轻微的稳定效应（2-4摄氏度）。分子对接结果使我们能够验证配体与GQ的相互作用模式，并估算结合亲和力。对于具有实验熔解温度（T(m)s）的配体，观察到了最高的结合亲和力。然而，稳定性和去稳定性配体均显示出相似的评分，而分子动力学（MD）模拟在广泛温度范围内对水溶液中的GQ（无论是未配体化还是与两种对T(m)s具有相反效应的模型PBT配体复合）进行，一致确认了CD所测定的其稳定或去稳定能力。我们的研究揭示了某些PBTs报道的抗癌活性与其稳定c-myc GQ结构能力之间关系的线索。此外，本文首次提出将高温分子动力学模拟作为验证配体对GQ稳定或去稳定效应的手段，并展示了其在靶向GQ药物发现中的预测潜力。
